text:
**Best pick for pool and beach: JBL Charge 6.** It has the strongest combined rating across these reviews.

- **Protection:** IP68, which is higher than the IP67 of most alternatives. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) and [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/) both name it their top overall pick.
- **Battery:** About 20 hours per What Hi-Fi, and up to 28 hours per [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/). The figures differ by source.
- **Price:** $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon per What Hi-Fi, and $150 on sale per Best Products. Check current prices before buying.

**Other good options by need:**

- **Floats and biggest battery:** JBL Boombox 4. RTINGS calls it its top pick, with over 40 hours of battery life and protection for long immersion. It's large and heavy, and its sound is narrow, so it can muffle if you're beside or behind it. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Mid-range, 360° sound:** Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM. It sounds consistent wherever you sit, floats, and costs less than the Boombox 4, but its battery is about 15 hours. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **Compact and portable:** JBL Grip, at $100 and about 0.85 lb, with IP68 and 12 hours of battery. Good Housekeeping says its mesh surface can look dusty after outdoor use. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Budget:** Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4, IP67, floats, up to 14 hours, $65 on sale per [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/).
- **Big party sound:** Soundcore Boom 2 Plus, IPX7, floats, up to 20 hours. It weighs 3.8 kg. The list price is $249.99, and code AFSC20 brought it to $200 when tested on 2026-10-22. The code expires 2026-12-31, and checkout has the final say. You can buy it here: [Soundcore Boom 2 Plus](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus). Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through that link, and the [product page](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-boom-2-plus) lists the same details.

**Protecting your speaker at the beach and pool:**

- IP ratings don't cover salt water or chlorine corrosion, and some manuals advise against beach use. Rinse with fresh water after use. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- Keep the speaker on a towel or raised surface, not buried in sand. Close all port flaps, and dry the charging area before plugging in a cable. [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/)
- Avoid speakers with no dust rating (like the Soundcore Boom 2) on sandy beaches. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

If you tell me your budget and whether you'll carry it far, I can narrow this down.
